newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian hotelier offers facilities for sale.
newsitem.headline: Croatian hotelier offers facilities for sale.

text.p: Croatian seaside hotelier Jadran on Friday offered for sale three hotels and other facilities in northern Adriatic resort of Crikvenica.

In an advertisement published in the daily Vecernji List, Jadran invited bids starting from 17.8 million marks for Hotel Jadranka, from 5.3 million marks for Hotel Miramare and 2.1 million for Pension Esperanto.
It also offered other business premises, including a caffe.
The tender is open to Croatian and foreign investors. It runs until January 30. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
